DELETE /applications/{}/commands/{}.title: Delete Global Application Command
DELETE /applications/{}/commands/{}.description: Deletes a global command. Returns 204 No Content on success.

DELETE /applications/{}/emojis/{}.title: Delete Application Emoji
DELETE /applications/{}/emojis/{}.description: Delete the given emoji. Returns 204 No Content on success.

DELETE /applications/{}/entitlements/{}.title: Delete Test Entitlement
DELETE /applications/{}/entitlements/{}.description: Deletes a currently-active test entitlement. Discord will act as though that user or guild _no longer has_ entitlement to your premium offering.

DELETE /applications/{}/guilds/{}/comman.title: Delete Guild Application Command
DELETE /applications/{}/guilds/{}/comman.description: Delete a guild command. Returns 204 No Content on success.

DELETE /channels/{}.title: Delete/Close Channel
DELETE /channels/{}.description: Delete a channel, or close a private message. Requires the MANAGE_CHANNELS permission for the guild, or MANAGE_THREADS if the channel is a thread. Deleting a category does not delete its child channels; they will have their parent_id removed and a Channel Update Gateway event will fire for each of them. Returns a channel object on success. Fires a Channel Delete Gateway event (or Thread Delete if the channel was a thread).

DELETE /channels/{}/messages/pins/{}.title: Unpin Message
DELETE /channels/{}/messages/pins/{}.description: Unpin a message in a channel. Requires the PIN_MESSAGES permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Channel Pins Update Gateway event.

DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}.title: Delete Message
DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}.description: Delete a message. If operating on a guild channel and trying to delete a message that was not sent by the current user, this endpoint requires the MANAGE_MESSAGES permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Message Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.title: Delete All Reactions
DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.description: Deletes all reactions on a message. This endpoint requires the MANAGE_MESSAGES permission to be present on the current user. Fires a Message Reaction Remove All Gateway event.

DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.title: Delete All Reactions for Emoji
DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.description: Deletes all the reactions for a given emoji on a message. This endpoint requires the MANAGE_MESSAGES permission to be present on the current user. Fires a Message Reaction Remove Emoji Gateway event. The emoji must be URL Encoded or the request will fail with 10014: Unknown Emoji. To use custom emoji, you must encode it in the format name:id with the emoji name and emoji id.

DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.title: Delete Own Reaction
DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.description: Delete a reaction the current user has made for the message. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Message Reaction Remove Gateway event. The emoji must be URL Encoded or the request will fail with 10014: Unknown Emoji. To use custom emoji, you must encode it in the format name:id with the emoji name and emoji id.

DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.title: Delete User Reaction
DELETE /channels/{}/messages/{}/reaction.description: Deletes another user's reaction. This endpoint requires the MANAGE_MESSAGES permission to be present on the current user. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Message Reaction Remove Gateway event. The emoji must be URL Encoded or the request will fail with 10014: Unknown Emoji. To use custom emoji, you must encode it in the format name:id with the emoji name and emoji id.

DELETE /channels/{}/permissions/{}.title: Delete Channel Permission
DELETE /channels/{}/permissions/{}.description: Delete a channel permission overwrite for a user or role in a channel. Only usable for guild channels. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Channel Update Gateway event. For more information about permissions, see permissions

DELETE /channels/{}/pins/{}.title: Unpin Message (deprecated)
DELETE /channels/{}/pins/{}.description: This endpoint is deprecated. Use Unpin Message instead.

DELETE /channels/{}/recipients/{}.title: Group DM Remove Recipient
DELETE /channels/{}/recipients/{}.description: Removes a recipient from a Group DM.

DELETE /channels/{}/thread-members/@me.title: Leave Thread
DELETE /channels/{}/thread-members/@me.description: Removes the current user from a thread. Also requires the thread is not archived. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Thread Members Update Gateway event.

DELETE /channels/{}/thread-members/{}.title: Remove Thread Member
DELETE /channels/{}/thread-members/{}.description: Removes another member from a thread. Requires the MANAGE_THREADS permission, or the creator of the thread if it is a PRIVATE_THREAD. Also requires the thread is not archived. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Thread Members Update Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/auto-moderation/rules/.title: Delete Auto Moderation Rule
DELETE /guilds/{}/auto-moderation/rules/.description: Delete a rule. Returns a 204 on success. Fires an Auto Moderation Rule Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/bans/{}.title: Remove Guild Ban
DELETE /guilds/{}/bans/{}.description: Remove the ban for a user. Requires the BAN_MEMBERS permissions. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Ban Remove Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/emojis/{}.title: Delete Guild Emoji
DELETE /guilds/{}/emojis/{}.description: Delete the given emoji. For emojis created by the current user, requires either the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. For other emojis, requires the MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. Returns 204 No Content on success. Fires a Guild Emojis Update Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/integrations/{}.title: Delete Guild Integration
DELETE /guilds/{}/integrations/{}.description: Delete the attached integration object for the guild. Deletes any associated webhooks and kicks the associated bot if there is one. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires Guild Integrations Update and Integration Delete Gateway events.

DELETE /guilds/{}/members/{}.title: Remove Guild Member
DELETE /guilds/{}/members/{}.description: Remove a member from a guild. Requires KICK_MEMBERS permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Member Remove Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/members/{}/roles/{}.title: Remove Guild Member Role
DELETE /guilds/{}/members/{}/roles/{}.description: Removes a role from a guild member. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Member Update Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/roles/{}.title: Delete Guild Role
DELETE /guilds/{}/roles/{}.description: Delete a guild role. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Role Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}.title: Delete Guild Scheduled Event
DELETE /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}.description: Delete a guild scheduled event. Returns a 204 on success. Fires a Guild Scheduled Event Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/soundboard-sounds/{}.title: Delete Guild Soundboard Sound
DELETE /guilds/{}/soundboard-sounds/{}.description: Delete the given soundboard sound. For sounds created by the current user, requires either the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. For other sounds, requires the MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. Returns 204 No Content on success. Fires a Guild Soundboard Sound Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/stickers/{}.title: Delete Guild Sticker
DELETE /guilds/{}/stickers/{}.description: Delete the given sticker. For stickers created by the current user, requires either the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. For other stickers, requires the MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. Returns 204 No Content on success. Fires a Guild Stickers Update Gateway event.

DELETE /guilds/{}/templates/{}.title: Delete Guild Template
DELETE /guilds/{}/templates/{}.description: Deletes the template. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns the deleted guild template object on success.

DELETE /invites/{}.title: Delete Invite
DELETE /invites/{}.description: Delete an invite. Requires the MANAGE_CHANNELS permission on the channel this invite belongs to, or MANAGE_GUILD to remove any invite across the guild. Returns an invite object on success. Fires an Invite Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /invites/{}/target-users/{}.title: Remove Target User
DELETE /invites/{}/target-users/{}.description: Removes a target user from an existing invite. Requires the caller to be the inviter or have the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

DELETE /lobbies/{}.title: Delete Lobby
DELETE /lobbies/{}.description: Deletes the specified lobby if it exists.

DELETE /lobbies/{}/members/@me.title: Leave Lobby
DELETE /lobbies/{}/members/@me.description: Removes the current user from the specified lobby. It is safe to call this even if the user is no longer a member of the lobby, but will fail if the lobby does not exist.

DELETE /lobbies/{}/members/{}.title: Remove a Member from a Lobby
DELETE /lobbies/{}/members/{}.description: Removes the provided user from the specified lobby. It is safe to call this even if the user is no longer a member of the lobby, but will fail if the lobby does not exist.

DELETE /stage-instances/{}.title: Delete Stage Instance
DELETE /stage-instances/{}.description: Deletes the Stage instance. Returns 204 No Content. Fires a Stage Instance Delete Gateway event.

DELETE /users/@me/applications/{}/role-c.title: Delete Current User Application Role Connection
DELETE /users/@me/applications/{}/role-c.description: Deletes the application role connection for the user. Requires an OAuth2 access token with role_connections.write scope for the application specified in the path.

DELETE /users/@me/guilds/{}.title: Leave Guild
DELETE /users/@me/guilds/{}.description: Leave a guild. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Delete Gateway event and a Guild Member Remove Gateway event.

DELETE /webhooks/{}.title: Delete Webhook
DELETE /webhooks/{}.description: Delete a webhook permanently. Requires the MANAGE_WEBHOOKS permission. Returns a 204 No Content response on success. Fires a Webhooks Update Gateway event.

DELETE /webhooks/{}/{}.title: Delete Webhook with Token
DELETE /webhooks/{}/{}.description: Same as above, except this call does not require authentication.

DELETE /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/@origina.title: Delete Original Interaction Response
DELETE /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/@origina.description: Deletes the initial Interaction response. Returns 204 No Content on success.

DELETE /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/{}.title: Delete Webhook Message
DELETE /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/{}.description: Deletes a message that was created by the webhook. Returns a 204 No Content response on success.

GET /guilds/{}/preview.description: Returns the guild preview object for the given id. If the user is not in the guild, then the guild must be discoverable.

GET /guilds/{}/prune.title: Get Guild Prune Count
GET /guilds/{}/prune.description: Returns an object with one pruned key indicating the number of members that would be removed in a prune operation. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD and KICK_MEMBERS permissions, unless the guild has the PRUNE_REQUIRES_ADMIN guild feature, in which case it requires the ADMINISTRATOR permission.

query.name: days
query.description: number of days to count prune for (1-30)

query.name: include_roles
query.description: role(s) to include

GET /guilds/{}/regions.title: Get Guild Voice Regions
GET /guilds/{}/regions.description: Returns a list of voice region objects for the guild. Unlike the similar /voice route, this returns VIP servers when the guild is VIP-enabled.

GET /guilds/{}/roles.title: Get Guild Roles
GET /guilds/{}/roles.description: Returns a list of role objects for the guild.

GET /guilds/{}/roles/member-counts.title: Get Guild Role Member Counts
GET /guilds/{}/roles/member-counts.description: Returns a map of role IDs to the number of members with the role. Does not include the @everyone role.

GET /guilds/{}/roles/{}.title: Get Guild Role
GET /guilds/{}/roles/{}.description: Returns a role object for the specified role.

GET /guilds/{}/scheduled-events.title: List Scheduled Events for Guild
GET /guilds/{}/scheduled-events.description: Returns a list of guild scheduled event objects for the given guild.

query.name: with_user_count
query.description: include number of users subscribed to each event

GET /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}.title: Get Guild Scheduled Event
GET /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}.description: Get a guild scheduled event. Returns a guild scheduled event object on success.

query.name: with_user_count
query.description: include number of users subscribed to this event

GET /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}/users.title: Get Guild Scheduled Event Users
GET /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}/users.description: Get a list of guild scheduled event users subscribed to a guild scheduled event. Returns a list of guild scheduled event user objects on success. Guild member data, if it exists, is included if the with_member query parameter is set.

query.name: limit
query.description: number of users to return (up to maximum 100)

query.name: with_member
query.description: include guild member data if it exists

query.name: before?
query.description: consider only users before given user id

query.name: after?
query.description: consider only users after given user id

GET /guilds/{}/soundboard-sounds.title: List Guild Soundboard Sounds
GET /guilds/{}/soundboard-sounds.description: Returns a list of the guild's soundboard sounds. Includes user fields if the bot has the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission.

GET /guilds/{}/soundboard-sounds/{}.title: Get Guild Soundboard Sound
GET /guilds/{}/soundboard-sounds/{}.description: Returns a soundboard sound object for the given sound id. Includes the user field if the bot has the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission.

GET /guilds/{}/stickers.title: List Guild Stickers
GET /guilds/{}/stickers.description: Returns an array of sticker objects for the given guild. Includes user fields if the bot has the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission.

GET /guilds/{}/stickers/{}.title: Get Guild Sticker
GET /guilds/{}/stickers/{}.description: Returns a sticker object for the given guild and sticker IDs. Includes the user field if the bot has the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission.

GET /guilds/{}/templates.title: Get Guild Templates
GET /guilds/{}/templates.description: Returns an array of guild template objects. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission.

GET /guilds/{}/threads/active.title: List Active Guild Threads
GET /guilds/{}/threads/active.description: Returns all active threads in the guild, including public and private threads. Threads are ordered by their id, in descending order.

GET /guilds/{}/vanity-url.title: Get Guild Vanity URL
GET /guilds/{}/vanity-url.description: Returns a partial invite object for guilds with that feature enabled. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission. code will be null if a vanity url for the guild is not set.

GET /guilds/{}/voice-states/@me.title: Get Current User Voice State
GET /guilds/{}/voice-states/@me.description: Returns the current user's voice state in the guild.

GET /guilds/{}/voice-states/{}.title: Get User Voice State
GET /guilds/{}/voice-states/{}.description: Returns the specified user's voice state in the guild.

GET /guilds/{}/webhooks.title: Get Guild Webhooks
GET /guilds/{}/webhooks.description: Returns a list of guild webhook objects. Requires the MANAGE_WEBHOOKS permission.

GET /guilds/{}/welcome-screen.title: Get Guild Welcome Screen
GET /guilds/{}/welcome-screen.description: Returns the Welcome Screen object for the guild. If the welcome screen is not enabled, the MANAGE_GUILD permission is required.

GET /guilds/{}/widget.title: Get Guild Widget Settings
GET /guilds/{}/widget.description: Returns a guild widget settings object. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission.

GET /guilds/{}/widget.json.title: Get Guild Widget
GET /guilds/{}/widget.json.description: Returns the widget for the guild. Fires an Invite Create Gateway event when an invite channel is defined and a new Invite is generated.

GET /guilds/{}/widget.png.title: Get Guild Widget Image
GET /guilds/{}/widget.png.description: Returns a PNG image widget for the guild. Requires no permissions or authentication.

query.name: style
query.description: style of the widget image returned (see below)

GET /invites/{}.title: Get Invite
GET /invites/{}.description: Returns an invite object for the given code.

query.name: with_counts
query.description: whether the invite should contain approximate member counts

query.name: guild_scheduled_event_id
query.description: the guild scheduled event to include with the invite

GET /invites/{}/target-users.title: Get Target Users
GET /invites/{}/target-users.description: Gets the users allowed to see and accept this invite. Response is a CSV file with the header user_id and each user ID on its own line. Requires the caller to be the inviter, or have MANAGE_GUILD permission, or have VIEW_AUDIT_LOG permission.

GET /invites/{}/target-users/job-status.title: Get Target Users Job Status
GET /invites/{}/target-users/job-status.description: Processing target users from a CSV when creating or updating an invite is done asynchronously. This endpoint allows you to check the status of that job. Requires the caller to be the inviter, or have MANAGE_GUILD permission, or have VIEW_AUDIT_LOG permission.

GET /lobbies/{}.title: Get Lobby
GET /lobbies/{}.description: Returns a lobby object for the specified lobby id, if it exists.

GET /lobbies/{}/messages.title: Get Lobby Messages
GET /lobbies/{}/messages.description: Returns the most recent messages in the specified lobby. The calling user must be a member of the lobby.

GET /oauth2/@me.title: Get Current Authorization Information
GET /oauth2/@me.description: Returns info about the current authorization. Requires authentication with a bearer token.

GET /skus/{}/subscriptions.title: List SKU Subscriptions
GET /skus/{}/subscriptions.description: Returns all subscriptions containing the SKU, filtered by user. Returns a list of subscription objects.

GET /skus/{}/subscriptions/{}.title: Get SKU Subscription
GET /skus/{}/subscriptions/{}.description: Get a subscription by its ID. Returns a subscription object.

GET /soundboard-default-sounds.title: List Default Soundboard Sounds
GET /soundboard-default-sounds.description: Returns an array of soundboard sound objects that can be used by all users.

GET /stage-instances/{}.title: Get Stage Instance
GET /stage-instances/{}.description: Gets the stage instance associated with the Stage channel, if it exists.

GET /sticker-packs.title: List Sticker Packs
GET /sticker-packs.description: Returns a list of available sticker packs.

GET /sticker-packs/{}.title: Get Sticker Pack
GET /sticker-packs/{}.description: Returns a sticker pack object for the given sticker pack ID.

GET /stickers/{}.title: Get Sticker
GET /stickers/{}.description: Returns a sticker object for the given sticker ID.

GET /users/@me.title: Get Current User
GET /users/@me.description: Returns the user object of the requester's account. For OAuth2, this requires the identify scope, which will return the object _without_ an email, and optionally the email scope, which returns the object _with_ an email if the user has one.

GET /users/@me/applications/{}/role-conn.title: Get Current User Application Role Connection
GET /users/@me/applications/{}/role-conn.description: Returns the application role connection for the user. Requires an OAuth2 access token with role_connections.write scope for the application specified in the path.

GET /users/@me/connections.title: Get Current User Connections
GET /users/@me/connections.description: Returns a list of connection objects. Requires the connections OAuth2 scope.

GET /users/@me/guilds.title: Get Current User Guilds
GET /users/@me/guilds.description: Returns a list of partial guild objects the current user is a member of. For OAuth2, requires the guilds scope.

query.name: before
query.description: get guilds before this guild ID

query.name: after
query.description: get guilds after this guild ID

query.name: limit
query.description: max number of guilds to return (1-200)

query.name: shard
query.description: only return guilds in this shard (0 to max_concurrency - 1)

query.name: with_counts
query.description: include approximate member and presence counts in response

GET /users/@me/guilds/{}/member.title: Get Current User Guild Member
GET /users/@me/guilds/{}/member.description: Returns a guild member object for the current user. Requires the guilds.members.read OAuth2 scope.

GET /users/{}.title: Get User
GET /users/{}.description: Returns a user object for a given user ID.

GET /users/{}/application-identities/{}.title: Get Application Identities by User ID
GET /users/{}/application-identities/{}.description: Returns the application identities for the specified user and application. Use this endpoint to discover the exact external ID values (provider_type, provider_issued_user_id, and optional provider_id) for a user's application identities.

GET /voice/regions.title: List Voice Regions
GET /voice/regions.description: Returns an array of voice region objects that can be used when setting a voice or stage channel's rtc_region.

GET /webhooks/{}.title: Get Webhook
GET /webhooks/{}.description: Returns the new webhook object for the given id.

GET /webhooks/{}/{}.title: Get Webhook with Token
GET /webhooks/{}/{}.description: Same as above, except this call does not require authentication and returns no user in the webhook object.

GET /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/@original.title: Get Original Interaction Response
GET /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/@original.description: Returns the initial Interaction response. Functions the same as Get Webhook Message.

GET /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/{}.title: Get Webhook Message
GET /webhooks/{}/{}/messages/{}.description: Returns a previously-sent webhook message from the same token. Returns a message object on success.

query.name: thread_id
query.description: id of the thread the message is in

PATCH /applications/@me.title: Edit Current Application
PATCH /applications/@me.description: Edit properties of the app associated with the requesting bot user. Only properties that are passed will be updated. Returns the updated application object on success.

body.name: custom_install_url
body.description: Default custom authorization URL for the app, if enabled

body.name: description
body.description: Description of the app

body.name: role_connections_verification_url
body.description: Role connection verification URL for the app

body.name: install_params
body.description: Settings for the app's default in-app authorization link, if enabled

body.name: integration_types_config
body.description: Default scopes and permissions for each supported installation context. Value for each key is an integration type configuration object

body.name: flags
body.description: App's public flags

body.name: icon
body.description: Icon for the app

body.name: cover_image
body.description: Default rich presence invite cover image for the app

body.name: interactions_endpoint_url
body.description: Interactions endpoint URL for the app

body.name: tags
body.description: List of tags describing the content and functionality of the app (max of 20 characters per tag). Max of 5 tags.

body.name: event_webhooks_url
body.description: Event webhooks URL for the app to receive webhook events

body.name: event_webhooks_status
body.description: If webhook events are enabled for the app. 1 to disable, and 2 to enable

body.name: event_webhooks_types
body.description: List of Webhook event types to subscribe to

PATCH /applications/{}/commands/{}.title: Edit Global Application Command
PATCH /applications/{}/commands/{}.description: Edit a global command. Returns 200 and an application command object. All fields are optional, but any fields provided will entirely overwrite the existing values of those fields.

body.name: name
body.description: Name of command, 1-32 characters

body.name: name_localizations
body.description: Localization dictionary for the name field. Values follow the same restrictions as name

body.name: description
body.description: 1-100 character description

body.name: description_localizations
body.description: Localization dictionary for the description field. Values follow the same restrictions as description

body.name: options
body.description: Parameters for the command, max of 25. Only for CHAT_INPUT commands

body.name: default_member_permissions
body.description: Set of permissions represented as a bit set

body.name: dm_permission
body.description: **Deprecated (use contexts instead)**; Indicates whether the command is available in DMs with the app, only for globally-scoped commands. By default, commands are visible.

body.name: default_permission
body.description: Replaced by default_member_permissions and will be deprecated in the future. Indicates whether the command is enabled by default when the app is added to a guild. Defaults to true

body.name: integration_types
body.description: Installation context(s) where the command is available

body.name: contexts
body.description: Interaction context(s) where the command can be used

body.name: nsfw
body.description: Indicates whether the command is age-restricted

body.name: handler
body.description: Determines whether the interaction is handled by the app's interactions handler or by Discord. Only for PRIMARY_ENTRY_POINT commands

PATCH /applications/{}/emojis/{}.title: Modify Application Emoji
PATCH /applications/{}/emojis/{}.description: Modify the given emoji. Returns the updated emoji object on success.

body.name: name
body.description: name of the emoji

PATCH /applications/{}/guilds/{}/command.title: Edit Guild Application Command
PATCH /applications/{}/guilds/{}/command.description: Edit a guild command. Updates for guild commands will be available immediately. Returns 200 and an application command object. All fields are optional, but any fields provided will entirely overwrite the existing values of those fields.

body.name: name
body.description: Name of command, 1-32 characters

body.name: name_localizations
body.description: Localization dictionary for the name field. Values follow the same restrictions as name

body.name: description
body.description: 1-100 character description

body.name: description_localizations
body.description: Localization dictionary for the description field. Values follow the same restrictions as description

body.name: options
body.description: Parameters for the command, max of 25. Only for CHAT_INPUT commands

body.name: default_member_permissions
body.description: Set of permissions represented as a bit set

body.name: default_permission
body.description: Replaced by default_member_permissions and will be deprecated in the future. Indicates whether the command is enabled by default when the app is added to a guild. Defaults to true

body.name: nsfw
body.description: Indicates whether the command is age-restricted

PATCH /applications/{}/users/{}/identiti.title: Update Application Identity Profile
PATCH /applications/{}/users/{}/identiti.description: Updates the profile data on the user's matching Application Identity record. Returns an Application Identity Profile object.

PATCH /channels/{}.title: Modify Channel
PATCH /channels/{}.description: Update a channel's settings. Returns a channel on success, and a 400 BAD REQUEST on invalid parameters.

body.name: name
body.description: 1-100 character channel name

body.name: icon
body.description: base64 encoded icon

body.name: type
body.description: the type of channel; only conversion between text and announcement is supported and only in guilds with the "NEWS" feature

body.name: position
body.description: the position of the channel in the left-hand listing (channels with the same position are sorted by id)

body.name: topic
body.description: 0-1024 character channel topic (0-4096 characters for GUILD_FORUM and GUILD_MEDIA channels)

body.name: nsfw
body.description: whether the channel is age-restricted

body.name: rate_limit_per_user
body.description: amount of seconds a user has to wait before sending another message (0-21600); bots, as well as users with the permission BYPASS_SLOWMODE, are unaffected

body.name: bitrate
body.description: the bitrate (in bits per second) of the voice or stage channel; min 8000

body.name: user_limit
body.description: the user limit of the voice or stage channel, max 99 for voice channels and 10,000 for stage channels (0 refers to no limit)

body.name: permission_overwrites
body.description: channel or category-specific permissions

body.name: parent_id
body.description: id of the new parent category for a channel

body.name: rtc_region
body.description: channel voice region id, automatic when set to null

body.name: video_quality_mode
body.description: the camera video quality mode of the voice channel

body.name: default_auto_archive_duration
body.description: the default duration that the clients use (not the API) for newly created threads in the channel, in minutes, to automatically archive the thread after recent activity

body.name: flags
body.description: channel flags combined as a bitfield; PINNED can only be set for threads in forum and media channels

body.name: available_tags
body.description: the set of tags that can be used in a GUILD_FORUM or a GUILD_MEDIA channel; limited to 20

body.name: default_reaction_emoji
body.description: the emoji to show in the add reaction button on a thread in a GUILD_FORUM or a GUILD_MEDIA channel

body.name: default_thread_rate_limit_per_user
body.description: the initial rate_limit_per_user to set on newly created threads in a channel. this field is copied to the thread at creation time and does not live update.

body.name: default_sort_order
body.description: the default sort order type used to order posts in GUILD_FORUM and GUILD_MEDIA channels

body.name: default_forum_layout
body.description: the default forum layout type used to display posts in GUILD_FORUM channels

body.name: archived
body.description: whether the thread is archived

body.name: auto_archive_duration
body.description: the thread will stop showing in the channel list after auto_archive_duration minutes of inactivity, can be set to: 60, 1440, 4320, 10080

body.name: locked
body.description: whether the thread is locked; when a thread is locked, only users with MANAGE_THREADS can unarchive it

body.name: invitable
body.description: whether non-moderators can add other non-moderators to a thread; only available on private threads

body.name: applied_tags
body.description: the IDs of the set of tags that have been applied to a thread in a GUILD_FORUM or a GUILD_MEDIA channel; limited to 5

PATCH /channels/{}/messages/{}.title: Edit Message
PATCH /channels/{}/messages/{}.description: Edit a previously sent message. The fields content, embeds, flags and components can be edited by the original message author. Other users can only edit flags and only if they have the MANAGE_MESSAGES permission in the corresponding channel. When specifying flags, ensure to include all previously set flags/bits in addition to ones that you are modifying. Only flags documented in the table below may be modified by users (unsupported flag changes are currently ignored without error).

body.name: content
body.description: Message contents (up to 2000 characters)

body.name: embeds
body.description: Up to 10 rich embeds (up to 6000 characters)

body.name: flags
body.description: Edit the flags of a message (SUPPRESS_EMBEDS and IS_COMPONENTS_V2 only)

body.name: allowed_mentions
body.description: Allowed mentions for the message

body.name: components
body.description: Components to include with the message

body.name: files[n]
body.description: Contents of the file being sent/edited. See Uploading Files

body.name: payload_json
body.description: JSON-encoded body of non-file params (multipart/form-data only). See Uploading Files

body.name: attachments
body.description: Attached files to keep and their metadata. See Uploading Files

PATCH /guilds/{}.title: Modify Guild
PATCH /guilds/{}.description: Modify a guild's settings. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns the updated guild object on success. Fires a Guild Update Gateway event.

body.name: name
body.description: guild name

body.name: region
body.description: guild voice region id (deprecated)

body.name: verification_level
body.description: verification level

body.name: default_message_notifications
body.description: default message notification level

body.name: explicit_content_filter
body.description: explicit content filter level

body.name: afk_channel_id
body.description: id for afk channel

body.name: afk_timeout
body.description: afk timeout in seconds, can be set to: 60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600

body.name: icon
body.description: base64 1024x1024 png/jpeg/gif image for the guild icon (can be animated gif when the server has the ANIMATED_ICON feature)

body.name: splash
body.description: base64 16:9 png/jpeg image for the guild splash (when the server has the INVITE_SPLASH feature)

body.name: discovery_splash
body.description: base64 16:9 png/jpeg image for the guild discovery splash (when the server has the DISCOVERABLE feature)

body.name: banner
body.description: base64 16:9 png/jpeg image for the guild banner (when the server has the BANNER feature; can be animated gif when the server has the ANIMATED_BANNER feature)

body.name: system_channel_id
body.description: the id of the channel where guild notices such as welcome messages and boost events are posted

body.name: system_channel_flags
body.description: system channel flags

body.name: rules_channel_id
body.description: the id of the channel where Community guilds display rules and/or guidelines

body.name: public_updates_channel_id
body.description: the id of the channel where admins and moderators of Community guilds receive notices from Discord

body.name: preferred_locale
body.description: the preferred locale of a Community guild used in server discovery and notices from Discord; defaults to "en-US"

body.name: features
body.description: enabled guild features

body.name: description
body.description: the description for the guild

body.name: premium_progress_bar_enabled
body.description: whether the guild's boost progress bar should be enabled

body.name: safety_alerts_channel_id
body.description: the id of the channel where admins and moderators of Community guilds receive safety alerts from Discord

PATCH /guilds/{}/auto-moderation/rules/{.title: Modify Auto Moderation Rule
PATCH /guilds/{}/auto-moderation/rules/{.description: Modify an existing rule. Returns an auto moderation rule on success. Fires an Auto Moderation Rule Update Gateway event.

body.name: name
body.description: the rule name

body.name: event_type
body.description: the event type

body.name: trigger_metadata?
body.description: the trigger metadata

body.name: actions
body.description: the actions which will execute when the rule is triggered

body.name: enabled
body.description: whether the rule is enabled

body.name: exempt_roles
body.description: the role ids that should not be affected by the rule (Maximum of 20)

body.name: exempt_channels
body.description: the channel ids that should not be affected by the rule (Maximum of 50)

PATCH /guilds/{}/channels.title: Modify Guild Channel Positions
PATCH /guilds/{}/channels.description: Modify the positions of a set of channel objects for the guild. Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires multiple Channel Update Gateway events.

body.name: id
body.description: channel id

body.name: position
body.description: sorting position of the channel (channels with the same position are sorted by id)

body.name: lock_permissions
body.description: syncs the permission overwrites with the new parent, if moving to a new category

body.name: parent_id
body.description: the new parent ID for the channel that is moved

PATCH /guilds/{}/emojis/{}.title: Modify Guild Emoji
PATCH /guilds/{}/emojis/{}.description: Modify the given emoji. For emojis created by the current user, requires either the CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. For other emojis, requires the MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS permission. Returns the updated emoji object on success. Fires a Guild Emojis Update Gateway event.

body.name: name
body.description: name of the emoji

body.name: roles
body.description: roles allowed to use this emoji

PATCH /guilds/{}/members/@me.title: Modify Current Member
PATCH /guilds/{}/members/@me.description: Modifies the current member in a guild. Returns a 200 with the updated member object on success. Fires a Guild Member Update Gateway event.

body.name: nick
body.description: value to set user's nickname to

body.name: banner
body.description: data URI base64 encoded banner image

body.name: avatar
body.description: data URI base64 encoded avatar image

body.name: bio
body.description: guild member bio

PATCH /guilds/{}/members/@me/nick.title: Modify Current User Nick
PATCH /guilds/{}/members/@me/nick.description: Modifies the nickname of the current user in a guild. Returns a 200 with the nickname on success. Fires a Guild Member Update Gateway event.

body.name: nick
body.description: value to set user's nickname to

PATCH /guilds/{}/members/{}.title: Modify Guild Member
PATCH /guilds/{}/members/{}.description: Modify attributes of a guild member. Returns a 200 OK with the guild member as the body. Fires a Guild Member Update Gateway event. If the channel_id is set to null, this will force the target user to be disconnected from voice.

body.name: nick
body.description: value to set user's nickname to

body.name: roles
body.description: array of role ids the member is assigned

body.name: mute
body.description: whether the user is muted in voice channels. Will throw a 400 error if the user is not in a voice channel

body.name: deaf
body.description: whether the user is deafened in voice channels. Will throw a 400 error if the user is not in a voice channel

body.name: channel_id
body.description: id of channel to move user to (if they are connected to voice)

body.name: communication_disabled_until
body.description: when the user's timeout will expire and the user will be able to communicate in the guild again (up to 28 days in the future), set to null to remove timeout. Will throw a 403 error if the user has the ADMINISTRATOR permission or is the owner of the guild

body.name: flags
body.description: guild member flags

PATCH /guilds/{}/roles.title: Modify Guild Role Positions
PATCH /guilds/{}/roles.description: Modify the positions of a set of role objects for the guild. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Returns a list of all of the guild's role objects on success. Fires multiple Guild Role Update Gateway events.

body.name: id
body.description: role

body.name: position
body.description: sorting position of the role (roles with the same position are sorted by id)

PATCH /guilds/{}/roles/{}.title: Modify Guild Role
PATCH /guilds/{}/roles/{}.description: Modify a guild role. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Returns the updated role on success. Fires a Guild Role Update Gateway event.

body.name: name
body.description: name of the role, max 100 characters

body.name: permissions
body.description: bitwise value of the enabled/disabled permissions

body.name: color
body.description: **Deprecated** RGB color value

body.name: colors
body.description: the role's colors

body.name: hoist
body.description: whether the role should be displayed separately in the sidebar

body.name: icon
body.description: the role's icon image (if the guild has the ROLE_ICONS feature)

body.name: unicode_emoji
body.description: the role's unicode emoji as a standard emoji (if the guild has the ROLE_ICONS feature)

body.name: mentionable
body.description: whether the role should be mentionable

PATCH /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}.title: Modify Guild Scheduled Event
PATCH /guilds/{}/scheduled-events/{}.description: Modify a guild scheduled event. Returns the modified guild scheduled event object on success. Fires a Guild Scheduled Event Update Gateway event.

body.name: channel_id?
body.description: the channel id of the scheduled event, set to null if changing entity type to EXTERNAL

body.name: entity_metadata
body.description: the entity metadata of the scheduled event

body.name: name
body.description: the name of the scheduled event

body.name: privacy_level
body.description: the privacy level of the scheduled event

POST /invites/{}/target-users/bulk-delet.title: Bulk-Delete Target Users
POST /invites/{}/target-users/bulk-delet.description: Removes multiple target users from an existing invite. Requires the caller to be the inviter or have the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

body.name: user_ids
body.description: the IDs of users to remove, max of 1000 users

POST /lobbies.title: Create Lobby
POST /lobbies.description: Creates a new lobby, adding any of the specified members to it, if provided.

POST /lobbies/{}/members/@me/invites.title: Create Lobby Channel Invite for Self
POST /lobbies/{}/members/@me/invites.description: Creates a single-use guild invite to the lobby's linked channel, targeted at the calling user. The lobby must have a linked channel and the caller must be a member of the lobby. The invite expires after one hour.

POST /lobbies/{}/members/bulk.title: Bulk Update Lobby Members
POST /lobbies/{}/members/bulk.description: Adds, updates, or removes up to 25 members from the specified lobby in a single request. Members with remove_member: false (the default) are upserted — added if not present, or updated with the provided metadata and flags if already a member. Members with remove_member: true are removed.

POST /lobbies/{}/members/{}/invites.title: Create Lobby Channel Invite for User
POST /lobbies/{}/members/{}/invites.description: Creates a single-use guild invite to the lobby's linked channel on behalf of an application, targeted at the specified user. The lobby must have a linked channel. The invite expires after one hour.

POST /lobbies/{}/messages.title: Send Lobby Message
POST /lobbies/{}/messages.description: Sends a message to the specified lobby. The calling user must be a member of the lobby.

POST /stage-instances.title: Create Stage Instance
POST /stage-instances.description: Creates a new Stage instance associated to a Stage channel. Returns that Stage instance. Fires a Stage Instance Create Gateway event.

body.name: channel_id
body.description: The id of the Stage channel

body.name: topic
body.description: The topic of the Stage instance (1-120 characters)

body.name: privacy_level
body.description: The privacy level of the Stage instance (default GUILD_ONLY)

body.name: send_start_notification?
body.description: Notify @everyone that a Stage instance has started

body.name: guild_scheduled_event_id
body.description: The guild scheduled event associated with this Stage instance

POST /users/@me/channels.title: Create DM
POST /users/@me/channels.description: Create a new DM channel with a user. Returns a DM channel object (if one already exists, it will be returned instead).

body.name: recipient_id
body.description: the recipient to open a DM channel with

POST /users/{}/application-identities/{}.title: Delete Application Identity
POST /users/{}/application-identities/{}.description: Deletes one Application Identity and its associated profile data for the specified user and application. Use this endpoint when a stale provider-issued user ID prevents you from writing profile data for the user's current identity.

POST /webhooks/{}/{}.title: Execute Webhook
POST /webhooks/{}/{}.description: Refer to Uploading Files for details on attachments and multipart/form-data requests. Returns a message or 204 No Content depending on the wait query parameter.

query.name: wait
query.description: waits for server confirmation of message send before response, and returns the created message body (defaults to false; when false a message that is not saved does not return an error)

query.name: thread_id
query.description: Send a message to the specified thread within a webhook's channel. The thread will automatically be unarchived.

query.name: with_components
query.description: whether to respect the components field of the request. When enabled, allows application-owned webhooks to use all components and non-owned webhooks to use non-interactive components. (defaults to false)

body.name: content
body.description: the message contents (up to 2000 characters)

body.name: username
body.description: override the default username of the webhook

body.name: avatar_url
body.description: override the default avatar of the webhook

body.name: tts
body.description: true if this is a TTS message

body.name: embeds
body.description: embedded rich content

body.name: allowed_mentions
body.description: allowed mentions for the message

body.name: components
body.description: the components to include with the message

body.name: files[n]
body.description: the contents of the file being sent

body.name: payload_json
body.description: JSON encoded body of non-file params

body.name: attachments
body.description: metadata for the attachments

body.name: flags
body.description: message flags combined as a bitfield (only SUPPRESS_EMBEDS, SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS and IS_COMPONENTS_V2 can be set)

body.name: thread_name
body.description: name of thread to create (requires the webhook channel to be a forum or media channel)

body.name: applied_tags
body.description: array of tag ids to apply to the thread (requires the webhook channel to be a forum or media channel)

body.name: poll
body.description: A poll!

POST /webhooks/{}/{}/github.title: Execute GitHub-Compatible Webhook
POST /webhooks/{}/{}/github.description: Add a new webhook to your GitHub repo (in the repo's settings), and use this endpoint as the "Payload URL." You can choose what events your Discord channel receives by choosing the "Let me select individual events" option and selecting individual events for the new webhook you're configuring. The supported events are commit_comment, create, delete, fork, issue_comment, issues, member, public, pull_request, pull_request_review, pull_request_review_comment, push, release, watch, check_run, check_suite, discussion, and discussion_comment.

query.name: thread_id
query.description: id of the thread to send the message in

query.name: wait
query.description: waits for server confirmation of message send before response (defaults to true; when false a message that is not saved does not return an error)

POST /webhooks/{}/{}/slack.title: Execute Slack-Compatible Webhook
POST /webhooks/{}/{}/slack.description: Refer to Slack's documentation for more information. We do not support Slack's channel, icon_emoji, mrkdwn, or mrkdwn_in properties.

query.name: thread_id
query.description: id of the thread to send the message in

query.name: wait
query.description: waits for server confirmation of message send before response (defaults to true; when false a message that is not saved does not return an error)

PUT /applications/{}/commands.title: Bulk Overwrite Global Application Commands
PUT /applications/{}/commands.description: Takes a list of application commands, overwriting the existing global command list for this application. Returns 200 and a list of application command objects. Commands that do not already exist will count toward daily application command create limits.

PUT /applications/{}/guilds/{}/commands.title: Bulk Overwrite Guild Application Commands
PUT /applications/{}/guilds/{}/commands.description: Takes a list of application commands, overwriting the existing command list for this application for the targeted guild. Returns 200 and a list of application command objects.

body.name: id
body.description: ID of the command, if known

body.name: name
body.description: Name of command, 1-32 characters

body.name: name_localizations
body.description: Localization dictionary for the name field. Values follow the same restrictions as name

body.name: description
body.description: 1-100 character description

body.name: description_localizations
body.description: Localization dictionary for the description field. Values follow the same restrictions as description

body.name: options
body.description: Parameters for the command

body.name: default_member_permissions
body.description: Set of permissions represented as a bit set

body.name: dm_permission
body.description: **Deprecated (use contexts instead)**; Indicates whether the command is available in DMs with the app, only for globally-scoped commands. By default, commands are visible.

body.name: default_permission
body.description: Replaced by default_member_permissions and will be deprecated in the future. Indicates whether the command is enabled by default when the app is added to a guild. Defaults to true

body.name: integration_types
body.description: Installation context(s) where the command is available, defaults to GUILD_INSTALL ([0])

body.name: contexts
body.description: Interaction context(s) where the command can be used, defaults to all contexts [0,1,2]

body.name: type
body.description: Type of command, defaults 1 if not set

PUT /applications/{}/guilds/{}/commands/.title: Batch Edit Application Command Permissions
PUT /applications/{}/guilds/{}/commands/.description: This endpoint has been disabled with updates to command permissions (Permissions v2). Instead, you can edit each application command permissions (though you should be careful to handle any potential rate limits).

PUT /applications/{}/guilds/{}/commands/.title: Edit Application Command Permissions
PUT /applications/{}/guilds/{}/commands/.description: Edits command permissions for a specific command for your application in a guild and returns a guild application command permissions object. Fires an Application Command Permissions Update Gateway event.

body.name: permissions
body.description: Permissions for the command in the guild

PUT /applications/{}/role-connections/me.title: Update Application Role Connection Metadata Records
PUT /applications/{}/role-connections/me.description: Updates and returns a list of application role connection metadata objects for the given application.

PUT /channels/{}/messages/pins/{}.title: Pin Message
PUT /channels/{}/messages/pins/{}.description: Pin a message in a channel. Requires the PIN_MESSAGES permission. Fires a Channel Pins Update Gateway event.

PUT /channels/{}/messages/{}/reactions/{.title: Create Reaction
PUT /channels/{}/messages/{}/reactions/{.description: Create a reaction for the message. This endpoint requires the READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY permission to be present on the current user. Additionally, if nobody else has reacted to the message using this emoji, this endpoint requires the ADD_REACTIONS permission to be present on the current user. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Message Reaction Add Gateway event. The emoji must be URL Encoded or the request will fail with 10014: Unknown Emoji. To use custom emoji, you must encode it in the format name:id with the emoji name and emoji id.

PUT /channels/{}/permissions/{}.title: Edit Channel Permissions
PUT /channels/{}/permissions/{}.description: Edit the channel permission overwrites for a user or role in a channel. Only usable for guild channels. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Only permissions your bot has in the guild or parent channel (if applicable) can be allowed/denied (unless your bot has a MANAGE_ROLES overwrite in the channel). Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Channel Update Gateway event. For more information about permissions, see permissions.

body.name: allow
body.description: the bitwise value of all allowed permissions (default "0")

body.name: deny
body.description: the bitwise value of all disallowed permissions (default "0")

body.name: type
body.description: 0 for a role or 1 for a member

PUT /channels/{}/pins/{}.title: Pin Message (deprecated)
PUT /channels/{}/pins/{}.description: This endpoint is deprecated. Use Pin Message instead.

PUT /channels/{}/recipients/{}.title: Group DM Add Recipient
PUT /channels/{}/recipients/{}.description: Adds a recipient to a Group DM using their access token.

body.name: access_token
body.description: access token of a user that has granted your app the gdm.join scope

body.name: nick
body.description: nickname of the user being added

PUT /channels/{}/thread-members/@me.title: Join Thread
PUT /channels/{}/thread-members/@me.description: Adds the current user to a thread. Also requires the thread is not archived. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Thread Members Update and a Thread Create Gateway event.

PUT /channels/{}/thread-members/{}.title: Add Thread Member
PUT /channels/{}/thread-members/{}.description: Adds another member to a thread. Requires the ability to send messages in the thread. Also requires the thread is not archived. Returns a 204 empty response if the member is successfully added or was already a member of the thread. Fires a Thread Members Update Gateway event.

PUT /channels/{}/voice-status.title: Set Voice Channel Status
PUT /channels/{}/voice-status.description: Set a voice channel's status. Requires the SET_VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS permission, and additionally the MANAGE_CHANNELS permission if the current user is not connected to the voice channel. Users who are connected to the voice channel do not need the CONNECT permission (see Implicit Permissions). Fires a Voice Channel Status Update Gateway event.

body.name: status
body.description: new voice channel status (up to 500 characters)

PUT /guilds/{}/bans/{}.title: Create Guild Ban
PUT /guilds/{}/bans/{}.description: Create a guild ban, and optionally delete previous messages sent by the banned user. Requires the BAN_MEMBERS permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Ban Add Gateway event.

body.name: delete_message_days
body.description: number of days to delete messages for (0-7) (deprecated)

body.name: delete_message_seconds
body.description: number of seconds to delete messages for, between 0 and 604800 (7 days)

PUT /guilds/{}/incident-actions.title: Modify Guild Incident Actions
PUT /guilds/{}/incident-actions.description: Modifies the incident actions of the guild. Returns a 200 with the Incidents Data object for the guild. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission.

body.name: invites_disabled_until
body.description: when invites will be enabled again

body.name: dms_disabled_until
body.description: when direct messages will be enabled again

PUT /guilds/{}/members/{}.title: Add Guild Member
PUT /guilds/{}/members/{}.description: Adds a user to the guild, provided you have a valid oauth2 access token for the user with the guilds.join scope. Returns a 201 Created with the guild member as the body, or 204 No Content if the user is already a member of the guild. Fires a Guild Member Add Gateway event.

body.name: access_token
body.description: an oauth2 access token granted with the guilds.join to the bot's application for the user you want to add to the guild

body.name: nick
body.description: value to set user's nickname to

body.name: roles
body.description: array of role ids the member is assigned

body.name: mute
body.description: whether the user is muted in voice channels

body.name: deaf
body.description: whether the user is deafened in voice channels

PUT /guilds/{}/members/{}/roles/{}.title: Add Guild Member Role
PUT /guilds/{}/members/{}/roles/{}.description: Adds a role to a guild member. Requires the MANAGE_ROLES permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success. Fires a Guild Member Update Gateway event.

PUT /guilds/{}/onboarding.title: Modify Guild Onboarding
PUT /guilds/{}/onboarding.description: Modifies the onboarding configuration of the guild. Returns a 200 with the Onboarding object for the guild. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD and MANAGE_ROLES permissions.

body.name: prompts
body.description: Prompts shown during onboarding and in customize community

body.name: default_channel_ids
body.description: Channel IDs that members get opted into automatically

body.name: enabled
body.description: Whether onboarding is enabled in the guild

body.name: mode
body.description: Current mode of onboarding

PUT /guilds/{}/templates/{}.title: Sync Guild Template
PUT /guilds/{}/templates/{}.description: Syncs the template to the guild's current state. Requires the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns the guild template object on success.

PUT /invites/{}/target-users.title: Update Target Users
PUT /invites/{}/target-users.description: Updates the users allowed to see and accept this invite. Uploading a file with invalid user IDs will result in a 400 with the invalid IDs described. Requires the caller to be the inviter or have the MANAGE_GUILD permission.

body.name: target_users_file
body.description: a csv file with a single column of user IDs for all the users able to accept this invite

PUT /invites/{}/target-users/{}.title: Add Target User
PUT /invites/{}/target-users/{}.description: Adds a target user to an existing invite. Requires the caller to be the inviter or have the MANAGE_GUILD permission. Returns a 204 empty response on success.

PUT /lobbies.title: Create or Join Lobby
PUT /lobbies.description: Creates a new lobby for the application identified by a secret, or joins the calling user to the existing lobby with that secret if one already exists. Updates lobby metadata and the calling member's metadata on join.

PUT /lobbies/{}/members/{}.title: Add a Member to a Lobby
PUT /lobbies/{}/members/{}.description: Adds the provided user to the specified lobby. If called when the user is already a member of the lobby will update fields such as metadata on that user instead.

PUT /lobbies/{}/messages/{}/moderation-m.title: Update Lobby Message Moderation Metadata
PUT /lobbies/{}/messages/{}/moderation-m.description: Sets the moderation metadata for a lobby message. The metadata is app-scoped and delivered to active game clients via the Social SDK as a realtime message update. See Integrate Moderation for the full moderation flow.

PUT /users/@me/applications/{}/role-conn.title: Update Current User Application Role Connection
PUT /users/@me/applications/{}/role-conn.description: Updates and returns the application role connection for the user. Requires an OAuth2 access token with role_connections.write scope for the application specified in the path.

body.name: platform_name
body.description: the vanity name of the platform a bot has connected (max 50 characters)

body.name: platform_username
body.description: the username on the platform a bot has connected (max 100 characters)

body.name: metadata
body.description: object mapping application role connection metadata keys to their string-ified value (max 100 characters) for the user on the platform a bot has connected
